fullTextParagraphs: Hilton Honors delivers greater transparency for members looking to upgrade their stay, while preserving signature moments of surprise and delight.
The new Upgrade at Digital Check-In capability gives eligible members real-time visibility into both complimentary and paid upgrade options directly within the Hilton Honors app.
Confirmable Upgrade Rewards introduce guaranteed, bookable suite upgrades for Hilton’s most frequent guests, offering certainty and a more seamless travel experience from the moment of booking.

Upgrades have long been one of the most talked about and highly anticipated benefits for loyal members during their travel journeys. In 2026, Hilton Honors launched exciting changes to its loyalty program, debuting a new premium tier and a faster path to Gold and Diamond status. As part of its ongoing evolution, Hilton Honors also continues to redefine the room upgrade experience to make it more transparent, more flexible, and more rewarding than ever, giving members greater choice and confidence while still leaving room for genuine moments of surprise and delight.

Hilton Honors’ latest upgrades evolution builds on its existing Automated Upgrade program, introducing multiple new ways for members, especially elite travelers, to enjoy enhanced stays, whether they prefer to plan ahead or enjoy an unexpected surprise before arrival.
This article is part of “Point Taken,” a Stories From Hilton series that takes a closer look at Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest loyalty program.
More Visibility, More Control with “Upgrade at Digital Check-In”

Recently rolled out across the Hilton global portfolio, Hilton Honors’ new "Upgrade at Digital Check-In" gives Gold, Diamond, and Diamond Reserve Members another complimentary upgrade opportunity, directly within the Hilton Honors app during the digital check-in experience. For the first time, eligible members can view both complimentary and paid upgrade options during digital check-in, rather than wondering what might be available or needing to ask at the front desk.

This experience builds on automated prearrival upgrades by clearly showing what’s available at the time of check-in, delivering happier arrivals for guests while streamlining the process for hotel team members. The program will continue to evolve as Hilton Honors gathers member feedback and insights, reinforcing a guest-first approach that adapts to member preferences and focuses on a frictionless travel experience.
Defining the Ultimate Upgrade for Hilton Honors’ Most Frequent Guests
For travelers who value certainty as much as comfort, Hilton Honors also recently introduced Confirmable Upgrade Rewards (CUR), a new 2026 benefit designed for its most elite members.

With a Confirmable Upgrade Reward, eligible members can lock in a guaranteed upgrade of up to a one-bedroom suite at booking, for stays of up to seven nights. No waiting, no wondering, no “maybe” – just peace of mind and a seamless start to the stay.

Confirmable Upgrade Rewards can be redeemed easily across Hilton’s direct booking channels, including Hilton.com, the Hilton Honors app, WeChat and Hilton Reservations & Customer Care Center, offering flexibility no matter how members choose to book. Additionally, Confirmable Upgrade Rewards can be used on both eligible paid and reward stays at select global Hilton properties offering complimentary pre-arrival upgrades. This includes hotels across the company’s growing luxury portfolio, featuring brands like Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts, Conrad Hotels & Resorts, LXR Hotels & Resorts, NoMad and Signia by Hilton.

Members can earn Confirmable Upgrade Rewards through achieving Diamond Reserve status, reaching the 120-night milestone reward or receiving a transfer or gift of a Confirmable Upgrade Reward from another Hilton Honors member.
A Loyal Experience, Designed for Real Travelers

Together, these enhancements reflect Hilton Honors’ broader commitment to continuously allowing for loyalty to evolve by thoughtfully balancing surprise with clarity, flexibility with simplicity, and innovation with hospitality. From automated and digital check-in upgrades to guaranteed confirmable suite upgrades, members now have more choices than ever in how they experience one of the most valued benefits in travel. For Hilton Honors, upgrades are no longer a single moment. They’re part of a thoughtfully designed journey that recognizes loyalty at every stage of the stay.

Room upgrades are one of the most valued benefits for our members. As expectations evolve, we’re enhancing the experience to deliver more transparency, flexibility and choice, while still preserving the moments of surprise and recognition that make travel memorable.

We’ve expanded how and when members can access upgrades, including real-time visibility at digital check-in alongside guaranteed options like Confirmable Upgrade Rewards for Hilton Honors’ most frequent guests.

Eligible members can view both complimentary and paid upgrade options directly in the Hilton Honors app during Digital Check-In. It removes uncertainty, streamlines the arrival process and gives members more transparency as they prepare for their stay.

Confirmable Upgrade Rewards allow eligible members to lock in premium room upgrades, including up to a one-bedroom suite for stays of up to seven nights, at the time of booking – including through the Hilton Honors app.

Whether through automatic upgrades, digital capabilities through the Hilton Honors app or Confirmable Upgrade Rewards, members have more ways to enjoy one of the most meaningful benefits of their loyalty.
It reflects our ongoing commitment to evolve with our members, delivering benefits that matter and offering more recognition and meaningful rewards.
Learn more about Hilton Honors at stories.hilton.com/hiltonhonors or visit hiltonhonors.com to enroll in the program today.
